title: GateControlStatus
description: Response of GET /audit/control on the control socket and, behind the session, on the phone listener (#916): whether the protected control-state checkpoint is enforced and, when it is, why the gate denies authority reads right now. denied is null while the checkpoint verifies. Only this flag and the reason; never the record, its hashes or any keychain content.
